decisions.reason: The stacking tray extends the core pallet display business, is produced cheaply on existing capacity, and its value is still uncertain after two years of website presence, so keeping the option open is justified.

The online portal is distant from the core offer, but it fits the firm's push toward deeper customer collaboration and costs little to maintain once built, so the option stays open while adoption remains uncertain.
Winning the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024 is a strong positive signal about the value of this packaging display, which justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display is close to the core offer, has its own showcase page, and uses existing production, so keeping this low-cost option is sensible.
The small counter display is a standard, low-cost extension of the core range with dedicated web presence, and one year has not yet revealed whether it will succeed.
The freestanding information display fits the firm's display-only focus and existing capabilities, so keeping it costs little while its prospects are still uncertain.
